name: RevoCure VR
summary: RevoCure represents a new standard in enhancing cognitive and motor skills. Choose from a variety of exercises to train your abilities, including concentration, reflexes, memory, sensory balance, and motor skills. It also allows for relaxation practices, and when used with a dedicated HRV sensor, it enables interactive breathing training. You can work independently or with a caregiver who, through an additional mobile app, can monitor your progress. By recording results, both you and the app user can track
